391325: A young girl who was rescued by Ephtal while being subjected to unjust treatment as a slave, and who ends up joining him on his journey. She is reserved but strong-willed, and refers to Ephtal—who saved her—as “Lord Ephtal,” placing deep trust in him.
391326: This is the current Ephtal, who has been reincarnated twice. He has set his sights on the path of magic and is aiming to enroll in a magic academy.
391327: After the Demon King was defeated, she was found by Ephtal in the Demon King’s castle—which was on the verge of collapse—and raised by him from infancy. As her background suggests, she is a descendant of the Demon King’s clan.
398525: Iria is the mother of Ephtal.
398526: The second son of the Duke of Alcott and Ephtal's older half-brother. He looks out for Iria and Ephtal—who are treated poorly due to their lack of aptitude—supporting them by providing living expenses and teaching them academics and swordsmanship.
405856: A top-performing student at the Altena Magic Academy, he boasts ability that ranks among the best in his year.
